WHAT: iOS 26 introduces Liquid Glass design system and several API updates relevant to SwiftUI apps.
HOW:
```swift
// Glass effect on buttons
Button("Keep") { ... }.glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule)

// Group morphing glass buttons
GlassEffectContainer {
  HStack {
    Button("Delete") { ... }.glassEffect(.regular, in: .capsule)
    Button("Keep") { ... }.glassEffect(.regular, in: .capsule)
  }
}

// Transition animation
.glassEffectID("actionBar", in: namespace)

// Fallback for iOS 17
if #available(iOS 26, *) { .glassEffect(...) } else { .ultraThinMaterial }

// Photos: prefer UTType over string
if asset.contentType == .screenshot { ... }

// StoreKit 2: new multi-entitlement API
for await entitlement in Transaction.currentEntitlements(for: premiumProductID) { ... }
```
GOTCHA: Firebase iOS SDK must be 11.14+ to avoid FirebaseInstallations crash on iOS 26. Call GADMobileAds.sharedInstance().start() AFTER Firebase init.
